projectInfo.name: Asset Manager
projectInfo.description: Multi-module Spring Boot application for asset management with image processing capabilities

modules.name: web
modules.description: Handles file uploads, REST APIs, and UI

incidents.title: AWS S3 SDK usage in web module
incidents.description: Web module uses AWS S3 SDK (software.amazon.awssdk:s3:2.25.13) for object storage operations
incidents.impact: Direct dependency on AWS services prevents cloud portability
incidents.recommendation: Migrate to Azure Blob Storage SDK (com.azure:azure-storage-blob)

incidents.title: AWS S3 SDK usage in worker module
incidents.description: Worker module uses AWS S3 SDK for thumbnail processing and storage
incidents.impact: Direct dependency on AWS services prevents cloud portability
incidents.recommendation: Migrate to Azure Blob Storage SDK (com.azure:azure-storage-blob)

incidents.title: S3Client bean configuration in web module
incidents.description: Uses AWS SDK S3Client with static credentials for storage operations
incidents.impact: Requires refactoring for Azure Blob Storage client
incidents.recommendation: Replace with BlobServiceClient using DefaultAzureCredential

incidents.title: S3Client bean configuration in worker module
incidents.description: Uses AWS SDK S3Client with static credentials for thumbnail operations
incidents.impact: Requires refactoring for Azure Blob Storage client
incidents.recommendation: Replace with BlobServiceClient using DefaultAzureCredential

incidents.title: AWS S3 operations in AwsS3Service
incidents.description: Service implements AWS-specific operations: PutObjectRequest, GetObjectRequest, DeleteObjectRequest, ListObjectsV2Request
incidents.impact: Multiple AWS-specific API calls need Azure equivalents
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Blob Storage operations: uploadBlob, downloadBlob, deleteBlob, listBlobs

incidents.title: AWS S3 operations in S3FileProcessingService
incidents.description: Worker service uses AWS S3 operations for thumbnail generation workflow
incidents.impact: Thumbnail processing logic tied to AWS S3 API
incidents.recommendation: Refactor to use Azure Blob Storage API for image processing

incidents.title: Static AWS credentials in web configuration
incidents.description: Uses AwsBasicCredentials with @Value annotations for accessKey and secretKey
incidents.impact: Security vulnerability - credentials in configuration files
incidents.recommendation: Migrate to Azure Managed Identity with DefaultAzureCredential - no explicit credentials needed

incidents.title: Static AWS credentials in worker configuration
incidents.description: Uses AwsBasicCredentials with @Value annotations for accessKeyId and secretKey
incidents.impact: Security vulnerability - credentials in configuration files
incidents.recommendation: Migrate to Azure Managed Identity with DefaultAzureCredential - no explicit credentials needed

incidents.title: Hardcoded RabbitMQ credentials in web module
incidents.description: RabbitMQ username and password hardcoded in properties file
incidents.impact: Security risk with default guest/guest credentials
incidents.recommendation: Use Azure Key Vault for secrets or Azure Service Bus with Managed Identity (no credentials needed)

incidents.title: Hardcoded RabbitMQ credentials in worker module
incidents.description: RabbitMQ username and password hardcoded in properties file
incidents.impact: Security risk with default guest/guest credentials
incidents.recommendation: Use Azure Key Vault for secrets or Azure Service Bus with Managed Identity (no credentials needed)

incidents.title: RabbitMQ dependency in web module
incidents.description: Uses spring-boot-starter-amqp (RabbitMQ) for message queue operations
incidents.impact: Requires migration to Azure Service Bus for cloud-native messaging
incidents.recommendation: Replace with spring-cloud-azure-starter-servicebus dependency

incidents.title: RabbitMQ dependency in worker module
incidents.description: Uses spring-boot-starter-amqp (RabbitMQ) for message queue operations
incidents.impact: Requires migration to Azure Service Bus for cloud-native messaging
incidents.recommendation: Replace with spring-cloud-azure-starter-servicebus dependency

incidents.title: RabbitTemplate usage in AwsS3Service
incidents.description: Uses RabbitTemplate.convertAndSend() for sending image processing messages
incidents.impact: RabbitMQ-specific API requires Azure Service Bus equivalent
incidents.recommendation: Replace with ServiceBusSenderClient.sendMessage()

incidents.title: RabbitMQ configuration class
incidents.description: Custom RabbitConfig defines Queue, MessageConverter, and listener factory
incidents.impact: RabbitMQ-specific configuration needs Azure Service Bus equivalent
incidents.recommendation: Create ServiceBusConfig with queue/topic configuration for Azure

incidents.title: @RabbitListener usage in worker
incidents.description: Worker uses @RabbitListener annotation for consuming messages
incidents.impact: RabbitMQ listener needs replacement with Service Bus message processor
incidents.recommendation: Replace with @ServiceBusListener or ServiceBusProcessorClient

incidents.title: Manual acknowledgment mode in RabbitMQ
incidents.description: Uses AcknowledgeMode.MANUAL for message processing
incidents.impact: Manual acknowledgment pattern needs Azure Service Bus equivalent
incidents.recommendation: Use Service Bus complete/abandon message operations

incidents.title: Jackson JSON message converter
incidents.description: Uses Jackson2JsonMessageConverter for RabbitMQ message serialization
incidents.impact: Message serialization approach may differ in Azure Service Bus
incidents.recommendation: Azure Service Bus uses standard JSON serialization - verify compatibility

incidents.title: Queue name constant definition
incidents.description: Hardcoded queue name 'image-processing' in RabbitConfig
incidents.impact: Queue naming convention should follow Azure Service Bus standards
incidents.recommendation: Externalize queue name to configuration properties for Azure

incidents.title: Durable queue configuration
incidents.description: Queue configured with QueueBuilder.durable()
incidents.impact: Durability semantics differ between RabbitMQ and Azure Service Bus
incidents.recommendation: Azure Service Bus queues are durable by default - no code change needed

incidents.title: PostgreSQL connection string in web module
incidents.description: Hardcoded localhost database URL in properties
incidents.impact: Needs Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server connection string
incidents.recommendation: Use Azure PostgreSQL connection string with SSL enabled: jdbc:postgresql://{server}.postgres.database.azure.com:5432/{database}?sslmode=require

incidents.title: PostgreSQL connection string in worker module
incidents.description: Hardcoded localhost database URL in properties
incidents.impact: Needs Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server connection string
incidents.recommendation: Use Azure PostgreSQL connection string with SSL enabled: jdbc:postgresql://{server}.postgres.database.azure.com:5432/{database}?sslmode=require

incidents.title: Hardcoded database credentials in web module
incidents.description: Database username and password in plain text
incidents.impact: Security vulnerability - credentials should be in Azure Key Vault
incidents.recommendation: Use Azure Managed Identity for PostgreSQL or store credentials in Key Vault

incidents.title: Hardcoded database credentials in worker module
incidents.description: Database username and password in plain text
incidents.impact: Security vulnerability - credentials should be in Azure Key Vault
incidents.recommendation: Use Azure Managed Identity for PostgreSQL or store credentials in Key Vault

incidents.title: Spring Boot version 3.2.1
incidents.description: Using Spring Boot 3.2.1 which is not the latest LTS version
incidents.impact: Missing latest security patches and Azure SDK compatibility improvements
incidents.recommendation: Consider upgrading to Spring Boot 3.4.x for better Azure integration

incidents.title: No Application Insights integration
incidents.description: Application lacks Azure Application Insights for monitoring and diagnostics
incidents.impact: Limited observability in Azure environment
incidents.recommendation: Add spring-cloud-azure-starter-monitor dependency for Application Insights

incidents.title: No Azure App Configuration
incidents.description: Uses local properties files instead of centralized configuration
incidents.impact: Configuration management across environments not optimized
incidents.recommendation: Consider Azure App Configuration for centralized config management

incidents.title: StaticCredentialsProvider usage in web
incidents.description: Uses AWS StaticCredentialsProvider for authentication
incidents.impact: Non-cloud-native authentication pattern
incidents.recommendation: Replace with DefaultAzureCredential for Azure Managed Identity support

incidents.title: StaticCredentialsProvider usage in worker
incidents.description: Uses AWS StaticCredentialsProvider for authentication
incidents.impact: Non-cloud-native authentication pattern
incidents.recommendation: Replace with DefaultAzureCredential for Azure Managed Identity support

incidents.title: Region-specific configuration
incidents.description: AWS region specified as us-east-1
incidents.impact: Azure uses different region naming convention
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure region names (e.g., eastus, westus2) in storage account endpoint

incidents.title: Profile-based configuration for dev environment
incidents.description: Uses Spring profile 'dev' for local development
incidents.impact: Profile strategy should support Azure dev/test/prod environments
incidents.recommendation: Ensure Azure-specific profiles configured (azure-dev, azure-prod)

incidents.title: AWS-specific URL generation
incidents.description: Uses S3Client.utilities().getUrl() for generating object URLs
incidents.impact: URL format differs between S3 and Azure Blob Storage
incidents.recommendation: Replace with BlobClient.getBlobUrl() for Azure

incidents.title: Bucket name configuration
incidents.description: Uses 'bucket' terminology specific to AWS S3
incidents.impact: Azure uses 'container' instead of 'bucket'
incidents.recommendation: Rename configuration property to azure.storage.container-name

incidents.title: RabbitMQ connection configuration
incidents.description: RabbitMQ host and port configured for localhost
incidents.impact: Needs Azure Service Bus namespace connection string
incidents.recommendation: Replace with spring.cloud.azure.servicebus.namespace property

incidents.title: File size limits for uploads
incidents.description: Multipart file size limits set to 10MB
incidents.impact: Azure Blob Storage supports larger files - limits may be too restrictive
incidents.recommendation: Review and adjust based on Azure App Service plan limits (can support much larger files)

recommendations.title: Migrate AWS S3 to Azure Blob Storage
recommendations.description: Replace AWS S3 SDK with Azure Blob Storage SDK in both web and worker modules
tasks: Replace software.amazon.awssdk:s3 with com.azure:azure-storage-blob dependency
Replace S3Client with BlobServiceClient in configuration classes
Update AwsS3Service to use Azure Blob Storage API operations
Update S3FileProcessingService in worker to use Azure Blob API
Replace PutObject/GetObject/DeleteObject with uploadBlob/downloadBlob/deleteBlob
Update URL generation logic for Azure Blob Storage
Test all storage operations thoroughly

recommendations.title: Migrate RabbitMQ to Azure Service Bus
recommendations.description: Replace RabbitMQ with Azure Service Bus for cloud-native messaging
tasks: Replace spring-boot-starter-amqp with spring-cloud-azure-starter-servicebus
Create ServiceBusConfig to replace RabbitConfig
Replace RabbitTemplate with ServiceBusSenderClient
Replace @RabbitListener with @ServiceBusListener or ServiceBusProcessorClient
Update message acknowledgment logic for Service Bus
Configure Service Bus namespace and queue in Azure
Test message flow between web and worker modules

recommendations.title: Implement Azure Managed Identity
recommendations.description: Replace hardcoded credentials with Azure Managed Identity and Key Vault
tasks: Remove static AWS credentials from configuration classes
Implement DefaultAzureCredential for Blob Storage authentication
Configure Managed Identity in Azure App Service
Move database credentials to Azure Key Vault
Update Service Bus configuration to use Managed Identity
Remove all hardcoded credentials from application.properties
Test authentication in Azure environment

recommendations.title: Configure Azure PostgreSQL
recommendations.description: Update database configuration for Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server
tasks: Update connection strings for Azure PostgreSQL
Enable SSL mode (sslmode=require)
Configure firewall rules in Azure
Set up connection pooling for cloud environment
Test database connectivity from both modules

recommendations.title: Add Azure Application Insights
recommendations.description: Implement monitoring and diagnostics with Application Insights
tasks: Add spring-cloud-azure-starter-monitor dependency
Configure Application Insights connection string
Add custom telemetry for key business operations
Set up alerts and dashboards in Azure Portal
Test log aggregation and metrics collection

recommendations.title: Upgrade Spring Boot version
recommendations.description: Upgrade to Spring Boot 3.4.x for improved Azure SDK support
tasks: Update parent POM to Spring Boot 3.4.5
Review and update deprecated API usage
Test all modules after upgrade
Verify Azure SDK compatibility
Update documentation

phases.name: Security and Authentication
tasks: Implement Azure Managed Identity
Migrate RabbitMQ to Azure Service Bus
Remove hardcoded credentials
Set up Azure Key Vault for secrets

phases.name: Storage Migration
tasks: Migrate AWS S3 to Azure Blob Storage in web module
Migrate AWS S3 to Azure Blob Storage in worker module
Update storage operations and URL generation
Test file upload and thumbnail processing

phases.name: Database and Monitoring
tasks: Configure Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server
Implement Application Insights monitoring
Upgrade Spring Boot version
Optimize configuration management

required.purpose: Object storage for images and thumbnails
Hosting for web and worker modules

recommended.purpose: Secure storage for database credentials and secrets
